skills.name_jp: デラックス☆ファウンテン

skills.name_jp: 照らすのはわたしの焔

skills.name_jp: ホップステップ・ゲッチュ♡

skills.description_en: If you're not in the front halfway through the race, you will get a speed boost; the boost will be greater in Mile and Medium races

skills.name_jp: 我が覇道、阻むものなし

skills.description_en: Medium/Long・If you're NOT in the back of the pack during the first half of the Middle Leg, you will get a speed boost; (Oonige/Runaway) the effect changes to 'your speed will slightly increase and your stamina will recover'
skills.description_jp: 中盤始めに中団以前だと長時間少し前に出続ける、「大逃げ」が発動していると効果が変わり、持久力を少し回復して速度がわずかに上がる＜中距離/長距離＞

skills.description_en: Betweener・If you were in the second half of the pack at the start of the Middle Leg, then at a random point during the second half of the Middle Leg, you will get a speed boost; (Medium only) then, if you're in the first half of the pack when entering the Final Straight, you will get another slight speed boost
skills.description_jp: 中盤突入時に後方だと終盤が迫ったとき前に出る、中距離レースならその後最終直線に入ったとき前方だとわずかに前に出る＜作戦・差し＞

skills.name_jp: わやかわ♪マリンダイヴ
skills.description_en: During the Middle Leg, if you activate at least two skills and are in the middle of the pack, your speed will increase and your stamina will recover
skills.description_jp: 中盤に2回スキルを使い中団にいると持久力を回復し速度が少し上がる

skills.description_en: If you're in the first place two-thirds through the race, you will get a speed boost; the effect will greatly increase if the two-thirds point is on the third corner and if you were leading by at least 3 lengths during the Middle Leg
skills.description_jp: 終盤突入時に先頭だと少し前に出るそこが第3コーナーで中盤に大きく差をつけて先頭にいた場合すごく前に出る

skills.description_en: If you're chasing after another girl in the front during the Final Corner or beyond, your speed on the Final Straight will increase
skills.description_jp: 最終コーナー以降に前の方で追いすがっていると最終直線を走行中不屈の闘志で速度がすごく上がる

skills.description_en: In the second half of the race, increase speed when you recover stamina with your skills while being in front
skills.description_jp: スキルで持久力を回復するとレース後半で前のほうにいる時にレッツラゴー！と速度を上げる

skills.description_en: If you overtake someone in the front during the Final Corner, your speed will greatly increase
skills.description_jp: 最終コーナー以降に先団で追い抜くと煌めくような華麗な動きを披露し少しの間速度がすごく上がる

skills.description_en: If you activate at least 3 recovery skills, then in the second half of the race, your speed and acceleration will increase, and you'll recover more stamina
skills.description_jp: スキルで持久力を3回以上回復するとレース後半で勝利に向かい呼吸を整えて力強く踏み込んでいく

skills.description_en: At a random point in the second half of the race, your speed will increase and you will activate two of your gold skills at random, ignoring their conditions
skills.description_jp: レース後半どっかで速度をわずかに上げついでに使えそうなレアスキルを2つ条件を無視して発動させる

skills.description_en: After running downhill in the back of the pack during the Middle Leg or later, your speed will increase; if you're in Tokyo, your acceleration will increase too
skills.description_jp: レース中盤以降の下り坂で中団だと坂を下った後少しの間速度を上げる東京レース場ならさらにギアを上げる

skills.description_en: If you're in front during any second half straight, your speed will increase; bonus speed if you're first and there's another girl right behind you
skills.description_jp: レース後半の直線で前方にいると速度を少し上げ続ける、先頭で後ろのウマ娘との差が1バ身以内だと効果が増える

skills.description_en: With 200 meters remaining in the race, your target speed will increase if you're near the front, and you will also immediately speed up if you're close to the first position
skills.description_jp: 残り200m地点で前の方にいると速度を上げる、さらに先頭のウマ娘と近い場合パワフルな走りでわずかに前に出る

skills.name_jp: ゲインヒール・スペリアー
skills.description_en: During the Middle Leg, if you're not in the front and someone overtakes you, your stamina will greatly recover
skills.description_jp: 中盤に後ろの方で順位を下げた時に優しい光で持久力をすごく回復する

skills.name_jp: 大盛り！ファーストバイト！
skills.description_en: If you overtook someone at least three times during the Middle Leg but you are still in the second half of the pack during any downhill around the end of the Middle Leg, your speed will increase and your accelearation will slightly increase
skills.description_jp: レース中盤に3回追い抜いた場合終盤目前の下り坂で後方にいると少しの間速度が上がり加速力がちょっと上がる

skills.description_en: During the Final Corner or beyond, if you're in the top 4 and someone is about to overtake you, your speed will increase
skills.description_jp: レース終盤以降かつ最終コーナー以降に前の方で近寄られると速度を上げ続ける

skills.description_en: During the last corner, gain acceleration when aiming for the lead from the middle of the pack
skills.description_jp: 最終コーナーで中団から前を狙う時魂を燃え滾らせて加速力を上げる

skills.description_en: If you're in the front with 400 m remaining in the race, your speed will increase; bonus speed if you've activated at least 7 skills
skills.description_jp: 残り400m地点で先団だと速度を上げるそれまでに7回以上スキルを使っている場合はすごく上げる

skills.description_en: If you're in front during the second half of the Final Corner, your speed will increase; bonus effect if it's a long race and you were blocked from the side during the Middle Leg
skills.description_jp: 終盤以降の最終コーナー後半に先団にいると速度が上がる長距離レースかつ中盤に競り合っていた場合はものすごく上がる

skills.name_jp: 翳り退く、さざめきの矢
skills.description_en: If someone has been trying to overtake you in the first half of the pack during the Final Leg or beyond, then on the Final Corner, your speed will increase
skills.description_jp: レース終盤以降に先団で詰め寄られると最終コーナー以降に闘志を燃やして速度を上げ続ける

skills.description_en: If you're near the front during the Middle Leg and try to overtake someone, your speed will increase
skills.description_jp: レース中盤で前の方から仕掛け始める時に速度が上がる

skills.description_en: During any Middle Leg corner, if you're not in the front and there are at least three other uma musume-chan nearby, your speed will increase with the power of moe
skills.description_jp: 中盤のコーナーで中団以降にいるとき近くにウマ娘ちゃんが3人以上いると萌えパワーで速度が上がる

skills.description_en: During the Final Leg or beyond, if you're in the front during any straight, your speed will increase; if the straight is on the opposite side from the audience, your acceleration will slightly increase too
skills.description_jp: 終盤以降の直線で前方にいると意気揚々と速度を上げる、さらにそこが向正面の場合加速力をわずかに上げる

skills.description_en: If you've activated at least 2 skills during the Middle Leg, your speed will increase; bonus speed for every extra activation during the effect (max twice)
skills.description_jp: レース中盤にスキルを2回発動すると速度を少し上げ続ける、効果中スキルを発動すると2回まで効果が増える

skills.description_en: If you're in a good position during the Final Corner or beyond, your speed will increase; if there's still more than 400m left in the race, your acceleration will increase too
skills.description_jp: 終盤以降かつ最終コーナー以降に好位置にいると速度が上がるさらにゴールまで遠いと最高の走りで加速力がちょっと上がる

skills.description_en: If you maintain good position from the start to the second half of the race, your speed will increase
skills.description_jp: レース後半まで好位置を維持し続けるとレース中盤に勝利への道筋を見出し速度を上げる

skills.name_jp: フラワリー☆マニューバ
skills.description_en: If you overtake someone during the Final Corner or beyond, then: 1) if you're in the front, your speed will increase; 2) if you're in the middle of the pack, your acceleration will increase
skills.description_jp: 最終コーナー以降に前の方で抜くと速度が後ろの方で抜くと加速力が上がる

skills.name_jp: 心からのおもてにゃし
skills.description_en: If you stayed in the back of the pack for the entire first half of the race, then during the Final Corner, you will get a speed boost; the effect is stronger in Long races
skills.description_jp: レース前半中団以降に控え続けているとレース終盤以降かつ最終コーナー以降に少し前に出る、長距離レースなら効果が増える

skills.description_en: During any Middle Leg corner, if you detect another girl right behind you, your speed will increase and stamina will recover
skills.description_jp: 中盤のコーナーで先団を走行中後ろに他ウマ娘を検知するとわずかに息を入れ、速度が上がる

skills.name_jp: あなたに捧げるフリーポア
skills.description_en: During any downhill around the end of the Middle Leg, if you're 2nd on worse and close to the lead, your speed will increase; if it's a medium distance race, your acceleration will too
skills.description_jp: 終盤目前の下り坂で2番手以降かつ先頭から4バ身以内にいると少しの間速度が上がる、さらに中距離レースでは加速力がちょっと上がる

skills.name_jp: シュガーパレード・始動！
skills.description_en: If you're close to the lead at a random point during the second half of the Opening Leg, your speed will increase; in Short and Mile races, it will increase greatly
skills.description_jp: 中盤が迫ったどこかで好位置にいると少しの間速度が上がる短距離かマイルレースなら少しの間すごく上がる

skills.name_jp: いっぱいおあげんしぇ！
skills.description_en: Around the middle of the race, if you're near the front and about to overtake someone, your speed will increase; the effect is stronger in Mile races
skills.description_jp: レース中間付近で前の方から仕掛け始める時に少しの間速度が上がるマイルレースなら効果が増える

skills.description_en: During the Middle Leg, if you're in the first half of the pack but aren't in the lead, your speed will slightly increase, your stamina will recover, and you will drain stamina from all enemies ahead of you
skills.description_jp: レース中盤で好位置だと前方のウマ娘から持久力を吸い取り自分の速度を少し上げる

skills.description_en: During the first half of the Middle Leg, if you're in the front, your speed will increase and your stamina recover
skills.description_jp: レース中盤始めの方に前方にいると速度を少し上げ続けおまけに持久力を少し回復する

skills.description_en: If you're in a good position on any corner during the second half of the race, your speed will greatly increase; in Nakayama, your acceleration will also slightly increase
skills.description_jp: 後半のコーナーで好位置だと少しの間速度がすごく上がるさらに中山レース場ならスピードの能力に応じて加速力が上がる

skills.description_en: Chaser・If you're not in the front during the Final Corner, your acceleration will increase; it will increase greatly in 2400 m races
skills.description_jp: 最終コーナー以降で中団以降にいると加速力が上がる、2400mのレースならすごく上がる＜作戦・追込＞

skills.description_en: If you were in the back of the pack during a Final Leg corner, your speed on the last straight will increase depending on the number of times you've overtaken someone on the corner
skills.description_jp: 終盤以降のコーナーで後方から詰め寄ると最終直線で速度が上がる終盤以降のコーナーで追い抜いた回数に応じて効果が増える

skills.description_en: During the Final Straight, if you're not in the front, your speed will increase; bonus speed for activating skills while this is active (up to 3 times)
skills.description_jp: ラストスパートの最中なら最終直線で中団以降にいると速度を少しずつ上げ効果中スキルを発動すると3回まで効果が増える

skills.description_en: If you try to overtake someone during the second half of the Final Corner or later, your speed will increase; the effect will be stronger if someone previously overtook you from the middle of the pack during the Middle Leg
skills.description_jp: 終盤以降の最終コーナー後半以降に追い抜こうとすると速度が上がるレース中盤に中団で追い抜かれているとすごく上がる

skills.description_en: If you've overtaken at least two other girls after entering the Final Corner, then on the Final Straight, your speed will increase
skills.description_jp: 最終コーナー以降に2回追い抜くと抱いた誇りを力に変えて最終直線で速度を上げ続ける

skills.description_en: If you're in a good position with less than 350m remaining in the race and there's another girl right behind you, your speed and acceleration will increase
skills.description_jp: 残り350mを切って前の方で後ろのウマ娘との距離が近いと譲らぬ思いで抜け出しやすくなる

skills.description_en: If you run uphill during the Middle Leg or later while being in the middle of the pack, then after the finishing the hill, your speed will increase
skills.description_jp: レース中盤以降の上り坂で中団にいると坂を上りきった後、優雅にぶちかまして速度を上げる

skills.description_en: If you're blocked in the middle of the pack at the final corner, it will become easier to get out
skills.description_jp: 最終コーナー走行中に中団で競り合うと抜け出しやすくなる

skills.description_en: If you're top 3 with 400 m remaining in the race, your acceleration will increase
skills.description_jp: 残り400m地点で3番手以内にいると短い間加速力がちょっと上がるレース中盤に連続して競り合い続けた時間が長いほど効果と時間が増える

skills.description_en: If you try to overtake someone in the first half of the pack during the second half of the race, you will get a speed boost; (Short/Mile only) then, if you overtake someone during the Final Corner, your speed will slightly increase
skills.description_jp: レース後半に前方で追い抜こうとすると少し前に出る、短距離かマイルレースならその後最終コーナーで追い抜くと速度がわずかに上がる

skills.description_en: If you're in the second half of the pack on any downhill during the Middle Leg or later, you will use a little extra stamina to get a speed boost; then, during the Last Straight, if your motivation is at least Good, your speed will increase
skills.description_jp: レース中盤以降の下り坂で後方にいると持久力を少し使って短い間前に出るその後やる気が好調か絶好調だと終盤以降の最終直線で短い間速度が上がる

skills.name_jp: ぐるぐるマミートリック♡
skills.description_en: If you're in front after the final corner and about to overtake another girl, your speed and acceleration will increase
skills.description_jp: 最終直線を好位置で走行中前のウマ娘との距離が近いと抜け出しやすくなる

skills.description_en: Halfway through the race, if you're near the front, your speed will increase; if this is a dirt race, you will also recover stamina
skills.description_jp: レース中間付近で先頭付近だと速度を少し上げ続けるさらにダートレースでは持久力が少し回復する

skills.name_en: Close Encounters of the Literary Kind
skills.name_jp: 未知との遭遇、即ち物語
skills.description_en: If you're near the front during the Final Straight, your (target) speed will slightly increase; in Nakayama or Tokyo, you will also get a slight (immediate) speed boost
skills.description_jp: 終盤以降の最終直線で前方にいると速度が少し上がる、さらに東京レース場の中距離か中山レース場の2500mのレースでは少し前に出る

skills.description_en: If you're in the middle of the pack halfway through the race, your speed will increase; bonus speed if you're fully motivated
skills.description_jp: レース中間付近で中団にいると速度を少し上げ続ける絶好調なら効果が増える

skills.name_en: Wager on the Holy Night Stars
skills.name_jp: 運否、聖夜の星に賭ける
skills.description_en: Medium/Long・At a random point during the first half of the Middle Leg, you will slow down; then, if you're in the middle of the pack at a random point during the second half of the Middle Leg, your speed will increase; it will increase more the further you are from the first place
skills.description_jp: 中盤始めのどこかで速度を落とす、その後終盤が迫ったどこかで中団だと速度を少し上げ続ける、先頭から離れているとすごく上げ続ける＜中距離/長距離＞

skills.description_en: If you're in the middle of the pack during the second half of the Final Corner in the Final Leg, your speed will increase
skills.description_jp: レース終盤以降の最終コーナー後半で高みを目指して中団から速度を上げる

skills.description_en: With 200 meters remaining in the race, if you're not in the lead but also not in the back of the pack, your speed will increase; if there are at 3 other girls around you, you will also get an speed boost
skills.description_jp: 残り200m地点で2番手～中団にいると速度が上がるさらに近くにウマ娘が3人以上いるとわずかに前に出る

skills.description_en: The farther you are from the front during the final corner, the more will your speed increase
skills.description_jp: 最終コーナーで先頭から離されているとその距離が遠いほど頑張り続けて速度を少しずつ上げる

skills.name_jp: 奥義・常夏バーニング！！
skills.description_en: If you're in the first half of the pack (but not in the lead) with 200 m remaining, your speed will increase; bonus speed if the race is Short and you've overtaken someone since entering the Final Leg
skills.description_jp: 残り200m地点で前の方にいると速度が少し上がる、短距離レースで終盤以降に追い抜いていた場合はすごく上がる

skills.description_en: If you were in the middle of the pack during the Final Corner in the Final Leg and there was another girls nearby, then during the Last Straight, your speed will increase; if your Mood is Great, you will also get a slight (immediate) speed boost
skills.description_jp: 終盤以降の最終コーナーで中団にいるとき近くにウマ娘がいると最終直線で速度が上がるさらに絶好調ならわずかに前に出る

skills.description_en: During the second half of the race, if you're not in the front and someone is trying to overtake you, your speed will increase
skills.description_jp: レース後半に後方で詰め寄られるとマシマシの幸運パワーが身体に実り速度が上がる

skills.description_en: If you're in the second half of the pack during the second half of the race, your speed will increase; the more stamina you have remaining, the bigger the increase
skills.description_jp: レース後半に後方にいると残りの持久力に応じたロングスパートをかけて速度をわずかに上げ続ける

skills.description_en: If you're in front during the last straight, your speed will increase, and you will slow down two girls in front of you, and two girls behind you
skills.description_jp: 最終直線に入ったとき前の方だと速度を上げ、前2人後ろ2人までのウマ娘をちょっと萎縮させる

skills.name_jp: ときめきが呼ぶほうへ
skills.description_en: If you're in the middle of the pack on a downhill late into the race, your speed will increase
skills.description_jp: 終盤目前の下り坂で中団に控えていてゴールまで遠いとレースを思いっきり楽しんで速度を上げる

skills.description_en: If you're in the middle of the pack during the Final Straight, and you've overtaken someone since entering the final corner, your speed will increase (bonus duration if you're not popular)
skills.description_jp: 最終コーナー以降に追い抜いていた場合最終直線で中団にいると速度が上がる人気が低い場合は奮起して上げ続ける

skills.description_en: If you stay near the back of the pack without panicking during the first half of the race, your acceleration will increase on the Final Straight
skills.description_jp: レース前半、掛からず最後方付近に控え続けていると、最終直線で気合を爆発させて加速力が上がる

skills.name_jp: ごろりん！？パワードライブ
skills.description_en: If you're in the middle of the pack during any corner in the second half of the race, your speed will slightly increase; in Medium races, your acceleration will also slightly increase
skills.description_jp: レース後半のコーナーで中団にいると残り持久力に応じた時間速度が少し上がる、さらに中距離レースでは加速力がちょっと上がる

skills.description_en: If you're trying to overtake someone or someone is trying to overtake you during the first half of the Middle Leg, you will get a speed boost; (Medium only) then, if you're near the front at a random point during the second half of the Middle Leg, your speed will increase
skills.description_jp: レース中盤始めに追い抜こうとするか近寄られると少しの間少し前に出る中距離レースならその後終盤が迫ったどこかで前方だと短い間速度が上がる

skills.description_en: If you're in the lead on any straight in the last 60% of the race, your speed will slightly increase; if you're in Nakayama and you've activated the Great Escape skill, your acceleration will also slightly increase
skills.description_jp: レース中間付近以降の直線で先頭だと長めに速度を少し上げ続ける、さらに中山レース場で「大逃げ」が発動していると長めに加速力をちょっと上げ続ける

skills.name_jp: ノッてけ、マッシュアップ！
skills.description_en: During the Opening Leg, if you're in the first half of the pack and being blocked from the side, your speed will increase; in Mile races, your speed will increase greatly, but you will use a little extra stamina
skills.description_jp: レース序盤に前方で競り合ったとき速度を上げる、マイルレースなら持久力を使って速度をすごく上げる

skills.name_en: Arrow of Gold, Break up the Dark Clouds
skills.description_en: Halfway through the race, if you're in the middle of the pack, your speed will increase and your stamina recover
skills.description_jp: レース中間付近で中団にいるとき燦然と輝きを放って速度が上がり持久力を少し回復する

skills.name_jp: あっぱれ大盤振る舞い！
skills.description_en: During a Final Leg corner where at least 600 meters remain, if you're in front of the pack, your speed and acceleration will increase
skills.description_jp: 終盤以降のコーナーで前方にいる時ゴールまでが遠いと少しの間前に出て加速力がちょっと上がる

skills.description_en: If you were blocked from the side during the Middle Leg, then with 650 m remaining in the race, if you're in a good position, your acceleration will increase
skills.description_jp: レース中盤に競り合っていた場合残り650m地点で好位置にいると夢を叶えるため加速力を上げ続ける

skills.name_en: Driven by Light, the Heavenly Wolf Hunts
skills.description_en: If you're in the middle of the pack halfway through the race, your speed will slightly increase; the effect is longer in Medium races if your base Power is at least 1200
skills.description_jp: レース中間付近で中団にいると速度を少し上げ続ける中距離レースでパワーが十二分に高いと長めに速度を少し上げ続ける

skills.description_en: During the last straight of the Final Leg, if there are other girls closely behind you while you're in a good position, use extra stamina to increase your speed and get a slight speed boost

skills.description_en: Slightly increase velocity and very minimally increase acceleration after passing another runner toward the front late-race.

skills.name_en: The View from the Lead Is Mine!
skills.description_en: Slightly increase velocity when in the lead by a fair margin in the second half of the race.
Moderately increase velocity when closing the gap to runners ahead on the final straight.
Slightly increase acceleration when positioned toward the front on the final corner or later.
Moderately increase velocity when just breaking out of the pack toward the front on the final straight.
Moderately increase ability to break out of the pack when positioned toward the front with 200m remaining.
Very slightly increase velocity steadily with a long spurt starting halfway through the race.
Slightly increase velocity when positioned toward the front with 200m or less remaining.
Very slightly swell with the determination to be number one when positioned toward the front in the second half of the race.
Slightly increase acceleration when well-positioned upon approaching the final straight.

skills.name_en: Where There's a Will, There's a Way
skills.description_en: Slightly increase velocity when passing another runner toward the back on the final straight.
Slightly increase velocity on the final straight after passing another runner on the outside toward the back on the final corner or later.
Slightly increase velocity when positioned toward the front on the final corner.
Very slightly hang on to the advantage when positioned toward the front with energy to spare on the final straight.
Slightly increase velocity when positioned toward the front and close to the runner ahead or behind on the final corner or later.
Slightly increase velocity when passing another runner on the outside on the final corner or later. If the skill user engaged in a challenge mid-race, moderately increase velocity instead.
Moderately increase velocity on the final straight after passing another runner 3 times late-race.
Slightly increase velocity when passing another runner from midpack or further back on the final corner.
Slightly increase velocity and navigation after passing another runner 2 times late-race.
Slightly increase acceleration when in the lead on a corner late-race.
Slightly bolt down the track when well-positioned or aiming for the front from midpack on a straight in the second half of the race.
Slightly increase velocity when engaged in a challenge while well-positioned in the second half of the race.
Slightly increase velocity when passing another runner toward the front on the final corner or later.
Very slightly increase ability to break out of the pack on the straight after engaging in a challenge toward the front on the final corner or later.
Very slightly increase velocity steadily and very minimally intimidate runners ahead when in midpack in the second half of the race.
Slightly increase velocity when positioned toward the front after making it to the final straight without faltering.
Slightly increase acceleration in an attempt to move up on a corner late-race.
Very slightly kick forward when moderately tired while well-positioned halfway through the race.
Slightly increase velocity on the final straight after passing another runner in the front part of the pack on the final corner or later.
Very slightly increase velocity when positioned toward the front with about 300m remaining. If coming out of an uphill, moderately increase velocity instead.
Slightly recover endurance and very slightly increase velocity for a moderate duration when sitting off the pace on a corner in the second half of the race.
Slightly increase velocity when far from the lead on the final straight. If positioned around the very back, moderately increase velocity instead.
When competing for the lead if positioned in the midpack or further for the first half of the race, moderately increase velocity.
Slightly increase velocity when positioned toward the front on the final straight after engaging in a challenge on the final corner or later.
When near the inner rail midpack on the final corner or later, slightly increase velocity and ability to navigate smoothly on the final straight.
Slightly increase velocity in a dash for the lead after running calmly and according to plan up until the final straight.
Very slightly begin to advance when passing another runner while well-positioned around halfway through the race.
Slightly increase velocity when engaged in a challenge on the final straight.
Very slightly increase acceleration steadily when starting to make a move from midpack in the second half of the race.
Slightly increase velocity when engaged in a challenge toward the front in the second half of the race.
If positioned toward the back and racing calmly until the start of the final corner, when there are 300m remaining, slightly increase velocity continuously.
Moderately recover endurance when well-positioned mid-race.
Become very slightly empowered to keep the advantage when positioned toward the front and close to the runner behind on a straight mid-race.
Slightly increase velocity when pressured by or passing another runner while well-positioned on the final straight.
Slightly increase velocity when moving up from midpack on the final corner or later.
If the user engaged in a challenge on a mid-race corner, slightly increase acceleration when well-positioned late-race at least halfway through the final corner.
Slightly recover endurance with a glance at nearby runners when positioned toward the back on the final corner.

skills.name_en: I See Victory in My Future!
skills.description_en: Slightly clear a path forward depending on divination results when the way ahead is jammed late-race.
Very slightly aim for the front when passing another runner from midpack or further back on a corner late-race.
Having run the race calmly, slightly increase acceleration when making a move mid-race, or on a crucial corner late-race whilst in midpack.
Slightly increase velocity when positioned 3rd and about to lose late-race.
Moderately increase velocity in a true display of skill with 200m remaining after racing calmly.
Slightly recover endurance and very slightly increase velocity when in midpack around halfway through the race.
If positioned toward the front from the start of the race until the second half of the race, slightly recover endurance and very slightly increase velocity steadily.
If well-positioned at the start of the final straight, slightly increase velocity. If positioned near the front, moderately increase velocity instead.
Very slightly increase velocity when positioned toward the front on the third corner in the second half of the race. Or, very slightly kick forward when toward the front on the backstretch late-race.
Slightly increase velocity when well-positioned and close to the runner ahead with 300m or less remaining.

skills.name_en: A Lifelong Dream, A Moment's Flight
skills.description_en: Slightly consume endurance to moderately increase velocity for a moderate duration when close to the runner behind on the final straight.
If the user passed another runner on the final corner or later, slightly increase velocity when in the front part of the pack with 300m or less remaining.
From the midpack in the second half of the race, minimally increase velocity steadily for a duration based on remaining endurance.
Slightly recover endurance after activating 2 skills mid-race.
Moderately increase velocity on the final straight after being on the heels of another runner toward the front on the final corner or later.
Slightly increase velocity when positioned toward the front in the second half of the race after recovering endurance with a skill.
When passing another racer at the front part of the pack on the final corner or later, moderately increase velocity for a moderate duration.
Very slightly control breathing and kick forward toward victory in the second half of the race after recovering endurance with skills at least 3 times.
If positioned toward the front with 200m remaining, slightly increase velocity. Then, if also positioned near the leading Umamusume, move minimally forward.
Moderately recover endurance when overtaken toward the back mid-race.
Slightly increase velocity continuously when pressured by another runner and running out of energy toward the front on the final corner or later.
Slightly increase acceleration when aiming for the front from midpack on the final corner.

Slightly increase velocity for a moderate duration when in the front part of the pack with 400m remaining. If at least 7 skills have been activated, moderately increase velocity for a moderate duration instead.
Slightly increase velocity when pressured by another runner in the front part of the pack on the final corner or later.
Slightly increase velocity when starting to make a move from a position toward the front mid-race.
If positioned toward the front on a straight late-race, slightly increase velocity. If the straight is on the backstretch, also increase acceleration very minimally.
If well-positioned late-race on the final corner or later, slightly increase velocity. If there's a large distance left to the finish, also increase acceleration very minimally.
Slightly increase velocity mid-race after staying well-positioned from the start of the race up until the second half.
Slightly increase velocity when passing another runner toward the front on the final corner. If passing toward the back, slightly increase acceleration instead.
Take a minimal breather and slightly increase velocity when in the front part of the pack and there's another runner coming from behind on a corner mid-race.
Slightly drain endurance from runners ahead when well-positioned and pressured by another runner mid-race.
Slightly increase velocity continuously on the final straight after passing another runner 3 times on the final corner or later.
If positioned toward the front with 350m remaining and there is another Umamusume close behind, break out of the pack slightly more easily.
Very slightly increase ability to break out of the pack when engaged in a challenge in midpack on the final corner.
Very slightly increase ability to break out of the pack when well-positioned and close to the runner ahead on the final straight.
Give max effort when far from the lead on the final corner, very slightly increasing velocity steadily for a duration proportional to distance from the lead.
Slightly increase velocity with a surge of fortune when pressured by another runner toward the back in the second half of the race.
If positioned midpack on a downhill just before late-race and there's a large distance left to the finish, slightly increase velocity.

If the user passed another runner on the final corner or later, slightly increase velocity from the midpack onward on the final straight. If the user isn't one of the top favorites, keep steadily increasing velocity slightly.
If the user stayed toward the very back during the first half of the race without being rushed, slightly increase acceleration on the final straight.
If the user activates another skill on the final corner late-race, very slightly increase velocity. If racing at Nakayama Racecourse, moderately increase velocity instead.
Bonus points will be added to the carnival points obtained. This skill will disappear at the end of the event.
